pages.title: The Crystal That Touches
pages.text: A Direct I/O crystal only listens to the machine or store touching it. Place it against the chosen face, then Binder-link it into the network.$(br2)Sneak-use it empty-handed to switch mode. $(bold)Input$() pulls from the neighbor; $(bold)Output$() sends to it.

pages.title: Link Limits
pages.text: Draconium and Wyvern Direct I/O crystals allow 2 and 3 crystal links, with ranges of 32 and 64 blocks. The measurements for the higher-tier sample are no longer legible.$(br2)An idle machine often means the crystal touches the wrong face. Check contact, then switch mode once and test again.
